Politics · India

Multiple Indian groups plan protests and political actions

Various political groups and activists are planning demonstrations and actions across India. In Jammu and Kashmir, the National Conference has announced a protest in Delhi for statehood restoration, facing questions from other regional parties. Separately, activist Sonam Wangchuk has called for a 'second freedom movement,' with the Congress urging him to end a fast. In Kolkata, a mosque closure at the airport has led to warnings of peaceful protests.
